:::{#exm-newton-model}
#### The Newton step at $x = 2.5$

For the model $\quadmodelf{\step} = f(2.5) + 2.25\,\step + 2.5\,\step^2$ of @exm-quadratic-model,
$H = [5]$ is positive definite, so by @thm-newton-model its minimizer is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\step^* &= -H^{-1} g \\
&= -2.25 / 5 \\
&= -0.45.
\end{aligned}
$$

Setting the derivative $2.25 + 5 \step$ to $0$ gives the same $\step^*$,
and

$$
\begin{aligned}
2.5 - 0.45 &= 2.05 \\
&= x^{(1)}
\end{aligned}
$$

(@exm-newton-method).

<!-- no-figure: the model and its minimizer are graphed in the figure included right after this example -->

:::
